text:
The pedestrian's statement is admissible under the excited utterance exception to the hearsay rule, because it was made while the pedestrian was still under the stress of observing the accident and relates to the startling event. Although it contains an opinion about carelessness, the portion about failing to use a turn signal is a factual observation prompted by the event. Thus the statement may come in as an excited utterance.

CONFIDENCE: 75
